findings.title: Encompass Health announces indefinite closure of 90-bed Sea Pines Rehabilitation Hospital after flood evacuation
findings.publisher: Encompass Health Corporation (official press release, SEC Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1)
findings.exact_supporting_passage: The flooding resulted in substantial damage to Sea Pines, and the hospital remains closed indefinitely.
findings.service_line: Inpatient rehabilitation hospital; 90 licensed beds per company release
findings.access_consequences: Storm flooding Nov. 1–2 caused evacuation and closure; the rehabilitation hospital remains closed indefinitely. Patients were transferred to other appropriate facilities or discharged home. The partners are evaluating repairs or replacement, with no effective reopening date. Local inpatient rehabilitation capacity is reduced; the release does not establish that other hospitals or emergency departments are closed.
findings.affected_population: Sea Pines inpatients and greater Melbourne/Brevard County patients needing inpatient rehabilitation; exact patient count not reported; 90 beds is hospital capacity, not a count of displaced patients.
findings.evidence_notes: The physical closure occurred during November 1–2, 2026 storms, with exact closing date not separately stated; event effective_date therefore null. Formal first-party press release filed with SEC November 6, available prior to this hourly window but not recorded in the preceding 11:46 supplementary heartbeat. Newly recalled, not newly occurred within this hour. Production deduplication is not verified; do not advance without that check.
